answer: Each newcomer must climb a mesa of unpaid challenge rounds, paying a crystal fee that doubles for every other identity sharing its funding trail or write-style cluster. Only after the mesa is cleared can it draw from the oasis reward pool. So the k-th sibling pays 2^k crystals while still doing the rounds, and one flagged sibling voids every oasis claim on that trail. Cost of n fakes therefore grows exponentially while honest loners pay once.
